videos.caption: A six-year-old girl has been rescued alive in Timure, Rasuwa district, after being trapped under thick mud and debris for around three days following devastating flash floods in Nepal. Rescuers from the Armed Police Force heard her cries, carefully freed her, and later provided aid as she recovered. The emotional video of the muddy but conscious child, her eyes blinking, has gone viral, offering a rare moment of hope amid the disaster that has claimed hundreds of lives.  #NepalFlood #MiracleRescue #Rasuwa #FloodRescue #HopeInNepal
